`manifest.json` is the unchanged manifest published with
[`v0.1.0-rc.2`](https://github.com/senyo888/thermal-intelligence/releases/tag/v0.1.0-rc.2),
source `6d0833f20e9e071d94d2f09f00c1a4d4a34f1805`.
It preserves the earlier release identity. The [foundation check](../../../scripts/check_foundation.py) pins the module and licence
from the promoted v1.0.1 build. Branch-policy tests use synthetic payloads. This fixture
